review_response_tasks.stem: Handle the glass jars ____, so that you do not break them. (careful)
review_response_tasks.rationale: carefully：副词carefully修饰handle。；careful：此处需副词修饰动作，不能直接用形容词。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。

review_response_tasks.stem: I have often ____ about flying over our town. (dream)
review_response_tasks.rationale: dreamt：have后用过去分词dreamt，词典列明。；dreamed：dreamed同为过去分词，不因另一拼写而判错。；dream：have后需要过去分词。；dreaming：have后不能直接接-ing构成此完成时。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。

review_response_tasks.stem: This tool can open tins as well as cut string. For these two jobs it is ____ than the tool that only cuts string. (useful)
review_response_tasks.rationale: more useful：两项任务都可完成而另一只能完成一项，语境支持more useful。；useful：原级不直接接此than比较。；most useful：最高级不合than比较。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。

review_response_tasks.stem: Ms Park teaches our science class. She is our science ____. (teach)
review_response_tasks.rationale: teacher：表示教科学的人，用单数teacher。；teach：our science后需人物名词。；teachers：一个Ms Park对应单数，不是复数。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。

review_response_tasks.stem: Ben was ____ onto the bus when his ticket fell from his hand. (step)
review_response_tasks.rationale: stepping：was后进行时用stepping，双写p。；step：was后原形不成此主动进行时。；steping：漏双写p，不是规范词形。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。
